59/G.goal: Explain how VR resource optimization makes large multimodal VR content feasible for real-time interactive rendering across different deployment platforms, using the Majuli VR case study.
59/G.achieves: This equips the learner to identify and address resource limitations when understanding or implementing an interactive XR system, in line with the course aim of building XR systems with confidence.

59/O1.goal: Describe how the Majuli VR case study is optimized to meet the storage, computation, and network constraints of Oculus Quest 2 and smartphone/cardboard VR deployments.
59/O1.achieves: This gives the learner a practical framework for assessing content, device, and network trade-offs when deploying interactive VR systems, supporting the course aim of implementing XR systems with confidence.
